preconditions.description: d is a positive integer between 1 and 500.
s is a positive integer between 1 and 5000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value % d == 0 and sum(int(digit) for digit in str(return_value)) == s)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a number divisible by d with a sum of digits equal to s.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or all(int(digit) >= 0 for digit in str(return_value))
postconditions.description: If a valid number is found, all its digits are non-negative.
